scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const name of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) { try { fs.rmSync(name); } catch {} } if (!process.env.npm_config_user_agent || !process.env.npm_config_user_agent.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('artifacts/whisper119/dist/public', 'dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
